dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: And I'm not just bragging, y'hear? If you come up with any comments or suggestions while having fun here in our land, feel free to tell me any time.

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: Who knows? We might have already exactly what you're looking for by the time you come back around.

dialogues.speaker: Amina
dialogues.text: By the way, do take these souvenirs with you as mementos of your time here.
